summary: 62-year-old female from Mineral Point, Wisconsin, fell from a horse near Granite Falls, ~6 miles from the Green Mountain Trailhead; rangers and the Grand County Mountain Medic Response Team reached the group ~8:30 p.m. and stayed overnight with the group and horses; flown the next morning (Aug 29) by Northern Colorado Med Evac to Medical Center of the Rockies
location: near Granite Falls, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Grand County Mountain Medic Response Team
notes: NPS release dated 2017-08-30 (Monday, August 28; helicopter evac Aug 29).
